response.goal: Capture partnership requests from the Partners Gmail label, summarize them with an AI model, and add sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary, and a priority flag to Airtable while leaving low confidence requests for human review.

plan.step: Write a Python script to authenticate with the Gmail API, fetch new messages from the Partners label, and extract sender and body content.
Integrate an AI model to classify the email content, extract company information, request type, generate a 2-sentence summary, assign a priority flag, and determine a confidence score.
Implement logic to route low-confidence classifications for human review and filter them from automatic creation.
Write the processed lead data including sender, company, request type, summary, and priority flag to Airtable.

milestones.name: Gmail Extraction and AI Processing
milestones.deliverable: Working Python script connecting to Gmail, extracting emails, and processing them with an AI model for summarization and classification.

milestones.name: Airtable Integration and Review Workflow
milestones.deliverable: Fully tested pipeline writing records to Airtable and correctly routing low-confidence items for human review.

risks.risk: Hourly budget constraints might limit extensive testing of edge cases in email formatting.
risks.mitigation: Focus on standard partnership email templates first and handle edge cases as they arise.

risks.risk: AI model may frequently return low-confidence flags for ambiguous partnership requests.
risks.mitigation: Tune the prompt parameters and define clear classification criteria to minimize false positives.
